claims.slide_title: Recommendation: Niva Bupa Health Insurance ReAssure 2.0
claims.text: ReAssure+ gives unlimited reinstatement after the first claim (each claim up to base SI) and premium stays at entry age until a claim is paid.

evidence.text: ReAssure+: 1st claim triggers ReAssure+, forever. It is Unlimited. Each claim will be up to the Base Sum Insured. Pay the premium as per your entry age, till a claim is paid (the product may be repriced as per IRDAI guidelines).

Safeguard: Claim Safeguard - non-payable items covered (as per list I of Annexure I); Booster+ Safeguard - no impact on Booster+ if claim in a policy year is less than INR 50,000; Sum Insured Safeguard - CPI linked increase in Base Sum Insured. Safeguard+: non-payable items covered as per list I, II, III, IV of Annexure I; no impact on Booster+ if claim less than INR 1,00,000; CPI linked increase. Safeguard+ is an optional benefit and is available on payment of an extra premium.

30 Mins Cashless Claim Processing (pre-authorisation requests within 30 minutes, subject to receiving all documents). 10,000+ Network Hospitals (approximate, subject to change). 24X7 Customer Service. 2 Crore+ Lives Covered.

claims.text: Booster+ carries forward unutilised base SI up to 5X for Platinum+ and up to 10X for Titanium+ plans.

evidence.text: Booster+: Platinum+ - Unutilised Base Sum Insured carries forward to the next policy year, maximum up to 5 times of Base Sum Insured. Titanium+ - Unutilised Base Sum Insured carries forward to the next policy year, maximum up to 10 times of Base Sum Insured.
Variants Platinum+ and Titanium+. Base Sum Insured (INR): 5 Lacs, 7.5 Lacs, 10 Lacs, 15 Lacs, 20 Lacs, 25 Lacs, 50 Lacs, 100 Lacs.

Optional Benefits: Hospital Cash - up to INR 5 Lac BSI: INR 1,000/day; INR 7.5 Lacs to INR 15 Lac: INR 2,000/day; above 15 Lac: INR 4,000/day (minimum 48 hrs continuous hospitalisation, max 30 days per policy year). Personal Accident: choose from 1X / 2X / 3X / 4X / 5X of base sum insured, maximum up to INR 1 Crore.
